comment: The delay jack is read monophonic although the filter itself is polyphonic, AP.cpp:87, so one voltage moves the delay of every channel. The sum it is clamped into is a time in seconds rather than a voltage, which is why the range field reads 0 to 0.5. The module also configures a bypass from input to output, AP.cpp:80.
